title_en: Xiaomi Black Friday on Rakuten: only 5 deals are really cheaper
description_en:
Xiaomi's official Rakuten store runs HYPER BLACK FRIDAY until Nov 25, 1:59 JST. We checked the store's items one by one: 5 are cheaper only during the sale (3 price cuts, 2 with extra points), 3 are new-product pre-order prices, and 3 are popular items with no discount. Prices as of Nov 20, 2026.
